## Findings
- claim-1: For \(v_{r,s,t,n}\), \(i=s-t+1\), \(j=r-t+1\), and Theorem 4.8 gives the lower-adjoined generating family \(\{s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}\), of cardinality \(\binom{a+b}{a}\). [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 847-891]
- claim-2: For \(n=4m\), \(r=n-r=2m\), and \(i=j=m\), one has \(a=b=m\) and \(J_{v_{r,s,t,n}}=I_{w_{r,s,t,n}}\). [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 938-955]
- claim-3: Assuming the accepted internal minimality theorem in its numerical form, the ideal \[ I_{w_{2m,2m,m+1,4m}} \] requires at least \(\binom{2m}{m}\) homogeneous generators; hence it has an exponential generator lower bound.
## Strategy
For \(m\ge1\), set \(r=s=2m\), \(t=m+1\), \(n=4m\). Then
\[
i=s-t+1=m,\qquad j=r-t+1=m,
\]
and the bigrassmannian admissibility inequalities hold. Hence
\[
a=\min(2m-m,2m-m)=m,\qquad b=\min(m,m)=m.
\]
Theorem 4.8 supplies a \(\binom{2m}{m}\)-element homogeneous generating family for \(J_v\) [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 864-891]. Source-30 also identifies \(J_v=I_{w_{2m,2m,m+1,4m}}\) in the coinvariant algebra [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 950-955].

Conditionally, if an internal theorem established
\[
\mu_{\Lambda/I_{2m,2m}}(J_v)=\binom{2m}{m}
\]
and if the required integral reduction preserved this generator number in the full coinvariant algebra, then
\[
\mu(I_{w_{2m,2m,m+1,4m}})\ge\binom{2m}{m}
 \ge \frac{4^m}{2m+1}
 =\frac{2^n}{n/2+1},
\]
an exponential lower bound.

## Gaps
The requested standalone lower-bound corollary is **not established** by the supplied evidence.

No exact accepted internal theorem is identified that gives the numerical equality \(\mu(J_v)=\binom{2m}{m}\), rather than only inclusion-minimality of one displayed family. Also, the supplied equality \(J_v=I_w\) does not itself prove preservation of homogeneous generator number between the Grassmannian quotient \(\Lambda/I_{2m,2m}\) and the full coinvariant algebra. Source-30 presents the count here only as conditional on Conjecture 4.10 [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 942-955].

## Next
Provide an exact internal numerical-minimality theorem or indecomposables certificate for this family, and an integral ambient-ring reduction proving equality of the relevant homogeneous generator numbers.
